mines.mine_notes: Tailings reprocessing operation, Chihuahua state; agreement with Municipality of Parral via subsidiary Coanzamex (royalty payment $48-$88/month linked to silver price). FY2025 (year ended Sept 30, 2025): 1,612,142 t fresh tailings placed on leach pad; production 2,150,192 silver equivalent oz (SEO) consisting of 851,102 oz silver, 12,289 oz gold, 476 t copper, 609 t zinc; SEO sold 2,144,938 oz. Record revenue $72.5M (realized $33.80/SEO oz); net income $17.3M; operating cash flow $25.65M. Adjusted cash cost $18.35/SEO oz; adjusted AISC $23.72/SEO oz. No mineral reserves disclosed for Parral (tailings reprocessing).

Development project, Jalisco state (~25 km from Los Ricos North). Feasibility Study released June 2025: 15-year mine life, 79.9 Moz payable SEO (41.1 Moz Ag, 423.6 koz Au, 11.2 Mlb Cu); initial capex $227M; sustaining capex $100M; operating cash cost $11.59/SEO oz, AISC $12.78/SEO oz; after-tax NPV5% $355M, IRR 28% at $26.80/oz Ag, $2,330/oz Au. Construction decision targeted 2026 (bought-deal financing closed Nov 2025 raised net proceeds $96.4M). No production in FY2025.

notes: FY2025 MD&A used (year ended September 30, 2025, filed December 2025). Production = attributable (100% owned). Cash costs are 'adjusted cash cost per SEO' and 'adjusted AISC per SEO' (non-IFRS). Los Ricos North (PEA stage, open-pit oxide/sulphide, ~110.3 Moz payable AgEq) not included as a mine row; LRN M&I resource 196 Moz AgEq not separately tabulated in reserves_resources.
